scope: Local disposable MA11 replay database clone with synthetic accounts, document, evidence and leased evaluation task; no production database or model invocation
checks: live route Gold source and excerpt bound
changed or unavailable Gold evidence rejected
live corpus and ACL drift rejected
frozen Gold and code/config byte drift rejected
conversation history and visibility changes rejected
limitation: The clone has the evaluation execution-kind constraint needed by this test. This verifies the local database admission binder; it does not verify production migration, dedicated worker scheduling, paid-call admission, user-visible answer quality or G16 completion.
